title: Unglazed Tunisian Rice Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish made with rice, vegetables, and spices, cooked in a tagine and served in a lacquerware bowl, featuring a grassy and gooey texture, and providing an energizing meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomato paste, ground cumin, paprika, and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the rinsed and drained rice to the tagine, stirring to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Add the water to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice and vegetables with a fork and serve in a lacquerware bowl.
